copyEvents:
INSERT INTO heimdall_retention.event_identities(product_id,environment,event_id,tenant_id,recorded_at,payload_digest,kind,decision_id,routing)
SELECT e.product_id,e.environment,e.event_id,'tenant-1',e.recorded_at,e.payload_digest,
CASE WHEN d.request_event_id=e.event_id THEN 'request' WHEN d.terminal_event_id=e.event_id THEN 'terminal' WHEN r.recovery_event_id=e.event_id THEN 'recovery' ELSE 'ordinary' END,
coalesce(d.decision_id,r.decision_id),to_jsonb(ARRAY(SELECT sink_id FROM heimdall.audit_deliveries x WHERE x.product_id=e.product_id AND x.environment=e.environment AND x.event_id=e.event_id ORDER BY sink_id COLLATE "C"))
FROM heimdall.audit_events e LEFT JOIN heimdall.audit_decisions d ON d.product_id=e.product_id AND d.environment=e.environment AND e.event_id IN (d.request_event_id,d.terminal_event_id)
LEFT JOIN heimdall_capacity.reservations r ON r.product_id=e.product_id AND r.environment=e.environment AND r.recovery_event_id=e.event_id
copyDecisions:
INSERT INTO heimdall_retention.decision_identities(product_id,environment,decision_id,tenant_id,request_event_id,requested_at,resolution,terminal_event_id,recovery_event_id,resolved_at)
SELECT d.product_id,d.environment,d.decision_id,'tenant-1',d.request_event_id,d.requested_at,d.resolution,d.terminal_event_id,r.recovery_event_id,d.resolved_at
FROM heimdall.audit_decisions d JOIN heimdall_capacity.reservations r USING(product_id,environment,decision_id)
